original_judgment.explanation: Diagnosis correctly identifies payment-service as the affected service with payment latency exceeding the upstream caller's deadline, matching the ground truth (3s payment delay vs 2s caller timeout). Supporting evidence is strong and independent: metrics showing payment-service p50 ~3006ms and p95 ~3007ms far exceeding the ~2s order-service timeout, plus trace/log evidence of order-service 502s and ~2027ms checkout durations consistent with a ReadTimeout. The higher-level accurate mechanism is accepted; absence of the exact 3s/2s injection parameters is not disqualifying.
